setup: Register/start/reopen the minimal ephemeral typed definition and await start.WaitForOutputAsync(token).
assertion: Typed completion/output requires no cast, polling, raw command, or implicit registration.

setup: Register/start a durable typed workflow, park on ordinary Wait, deliver an event, and await typed output.
assertion: The application uses only the common registry/event/handle facade and fixed outcome metadata.
expectedRed: Final durable application facade is absent.

setup: Construct payloadless and fixed-codec typed inbound envelopes, then exercise direct and correlation routes through process-local engine support.
assertion: Both exact public envelope factories detach their values and all four route/shape combinations retain closed process-local results without exposing engine commands.
expectedRed: Exact inbound envelope contract is absent.

setup: Send identical/different envelopes with one EventId and send before a matching wait exists.
assertion: Identical accepted replay is Duplicate, changed content is EventConflict, NoActiveWait is non-consuming, and the same envelope can later be accepted.
expectedRed: Final event identity and dedup semantics are absent.

setup: Attempt two active waits for one definition/event/correlation pair, including within one instance.
assertion: AmbiguousWaitRegistrationException occurs before parking and no event target is selected.

setup: Consume a signal, complete that occurrence, start a later occurrence with the same event/correlation pair, and send a later event.
assertion: The later workflow occurrence consumes the later event; occurrence-specific meaning remains author-owned in CorrelationId.

setup: Deliver through callback-only ingress while the definition-owning engine is offline, then start competing continuation pumps.
assertion: Ingress commits inbox/dedup/handoff only; exactly one definition owner progresses after restart.
expectedRed: Split-host ingress and cold continuation handoff are absent.

setup: Inside one lease submit a Kubernetes job by StepOperationId, Wait, then run the immediate validation step before scope exit.
assertion: The step validates payload, Job UID, operation ID, protection token, and terminality while ResourceLease is still present.
expectedRed: Final scoped lease and scheduler journey are absent.
